name: TSG IT Advanced Systems Ltd
summary: TSG IT Advanced Systems Ltd provides technological products and solutions in the fields of defense, civil, and the municipal sectors. It offers command and control systems; intelligence systems; facility navigators, customer call centers, and recording systems; and 360-degree urban management, ERP systems, bar technologies, and Eshed property management systems. TSG IT Advanced Systems Ltd was founded in 1969 and is based in Or Yehuda, Israel.
